title.zh: 新加坡国立大学学生会及属会（豁免）命令
title.en: National University of Singapore Students’ Union and Constituent Bodies (Exemption) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the National University of Singapore Students’ Union and Constituent Bodies (Exemption) Order.

2. The National University of Singapore Students’ Union and its constituent bodies specified in the Schedule (each of which is referred to in this Order as an exempted entity) are hereby exempted from the provisions of the Societies Act (Cap. 311), subject to the following conditions:
(a)an exempted entity shall furnish the Registrar of Societies with such information concerning, and such documents, accounts and books relating to, the exempted entity as he may require;
(b)an exempted entity shall not use any flag, symbol, emblem, badge or insignia without the consent in writing of the Registrar of Societies; and
(c)an exempted entity shall not be used —
(i)for unlawful purposes;
(ii)for purposes prejudicial to public peace, welfare or good order in Singapore; or
(iii)for any purpose incompatible with the objects and rules of the exempted entity.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Constituent Bodies of the Union
1. Students’ Arts and Social Sciences Club.
2. Students’ Science Club.
3. Students’ Medical Club.
4. Students’ Dental Club.
5. Students’ Law Club.
6. Students’ Business Club.
7. Students’ Design and Engineering Club.
[S 292/2026 wef 14/05/2026]
8. Students’ NUS College Club.
[S 292/2026 wef 14/05/2026]
9. Students’ Computing Club.
10. [Deleted by S 292/2026 wef 14/05/2026]
11. Students’ Sports Club.
12. Students’ Cultural Activities Club.
13. Students’ Community Service Club.
14. Students’ Conservatory Club.
[S 162/2022 wef 04/03/2022]
